title: K1413's two leakage terms exclude bounded same-tier time-local polynomial normal-form closure

combined_boundary.admitted_class: bounded autonomous time-local polynomial normal-form corrections and coercively equivalent same-spatial-tier modified energies, with one charge-independent Maxwell-energy coefficient
combined_boundary.electric_result: K1435 supplies a nonzero periodic-orbit average in the retained harmonic Maxwell sector and incompatible q=4/q=8 Maxwell coefficients
combined_boundary.radial_result: K1436 supplies a nonclosed two-charge density one-form and a homological symbol growing like K^2
combined_boundary.joint_conclusion: No correction in the admitted class cancels or controls both K1413 leakage terms on the full multi-charge phase space while preserving the same spatial tier
surviving_routes: strict zero-harmonic Maxwell sector followed by nonzero-mode null-form or small-divisor analysis
derivative-losing corrections with a deliberately higher triangular tier
a summable infinite hierarchy with an explicit finite-tier Cauchy consequence
combined_boundary.claim_ceiling: This is a correction-class exclusion, not a no-go for cutoff-uniform global PDE evolution. It constructs no full-PDE flow, BV-BFV quotient, source selector or physical Hilbert cohomology
